from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FacultyComposition(BaseModel):
    """Faculty composition and student age data for one institution from a CDS report."""
    institution_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the institution")
    full_time_faculty_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of full-time instructional faculty (Section I-1)")
    part_time_faculty_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of part-time instructional faculty (Section I-1)")
    average_age_full_time_undergraduates: float | None = Field(description="Average age of full-time undergraduate students (Section F1)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    faculty_compositions: list[FacultyComposition]
